role_change: This authorized protocol replaces the old sealed-fixture role with seven outer leave-one-match-out folds. Preserve validation.json and historical artifacts unchanged. No competition data.
protocol: For each outer holdout, select decoder costs using six inner held-out fixtures with both heads trained on the remaining five. Reuse a model for an unordered pair of excluded fixtures. Refit heads on six for outer evaluation. Heads use historically selected fixed architectures: full/frame dead and full/spell ownership. Outer labels are not accepted by training/selection APIs. Architecture choices were informed by earlier experiments on six of these fixtures; nested decoder selection does not erase historical researcher adaptation.
label_sensitivity_rule: Evaluation only: iteratively absorb an H/A spell strictly shorter than 3 s when immediately flanked by the same opposite team within one uninterrupted alive run. Select shortest eligible first, earliest on ties. Never alter D or X, never cross periods; do not train or select on this alternate label set.
stress_policy: Contextual noise is evaluation-only and uses original x/y tracking plus RNG, never labels. Elevated gap-start probability for fast unsupported ball motion or crowded boxes is a proxy, not observed aerial height. Ghost positions can fill missing ball frames. Wrong-team errors swap coordinates between an observed home/away pair for bursts while membership stays fixed. Report realized noise and masks.
selection: Use unchanged decoder.json grid, equal inner-match/regime weighting, seed means, macroF1 tie-break. Do not select costs on outer results or alternate labels. Compare nested-selected decoder with prior fixed 40/40/8, old gap composition and official smooth50 on identical inputs.
uncertainty: Paired conditional GT-possession bootstrap within each outer match/condition, sharing draws and averaging corruption seeds. Also report descriptive paired match bootstrap across seven folds. These do not account for overlapping training sets or historical adaptation.
